macos.notes:
Scout v5.6.0.

**Mac** (Apple Silicon and Intel) — download `scout-macos.dmg`, open it, drag Scout to Applications, open Scout. Signed by Orage and notarized by Apple, so it opens with a double-click.

**Windows 10/11 (64-bit)** — download `scout-windows-setup.exe` and run it. It installs Scout for your user (no admin password needed) and adds Scout to the Start menu. It is not code-signed yet, so Windows shows "Windows protected your PC" once: click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

Prefer no installer? `scout-windows-x64.zip` is the same app as a plain folder — unzip it and run `Scout\Scout.exe`.

Built from Orage-Agency/Scout-Desktop@d7fb834 (main).
**Linux (64-bit)** — download `scout-linux-x64.tar.gz`, untar it (`tar xzf scout-linux-x64.tar.gz`) and run `scout-linux-x64/scout_desktop`. Scout is not offered as an automatic update on Linux; install it once by hand and re-download new versions from this page. For a per-user install with a launcher entry, use `scripts/install-linux.sh` from a local checkout instead.
